answer: Give reviewers influence in proportion to the real service credits they commit to an audit round. Whether they inspect an ocean forecast, a horizon scan or a vine disease report, count the sum of credits across ballots and consume each credit once. Splitting 100 credits among 100 aliases still buys exactly 100 units of influence. Issue credits only against verified deliveries and keep them locked until disputes close. An attacker seeking twice the influence must deliver twice the work or buy the credits at market price.
